added: 新增 macOS 版（Apple 芯片的 Mac）
界面支持英文，默认跟随系统语言
新增有道翻译：免费，国内可以直接用
识字完成后自动把文字复制好，不用再点一下（可以在设置里关掉）
可以下载更准的识字引擎 PaddleOCR：手写体、艺术字、复杂排版认得更准
划词翻译面板：原文可以直接改，可以置顶，四条边都能拖动改大小
剪贴板面板可以选单击粘贴还是双击粘贴
剪贴板面板从屏幕底下滑上来（可以在设置里关掉）
截图工具条的按钮顺序可以在设置里拖动调整
选区框新增「四角」线型
剪贴板面板可以盖在任务栏上面（设置里的开关）
improved: 软件改名为 DATO OCR，原来的数据和设置自动保留
长截图可以一口气滚到底，截完自动复制
截图工具条重新设计，图标更统一
翻译结果前面显示翻译服务的图标
识字结果可以用鼠标跨行拖动选中
划词翻译面板的输入框和翻译结果更清楚，不再和后面的文字叠在一起
截图识字不再自动框选窗口，由你自己拖出要识别的范围
fixed: 毛玻璃面板的圆角外面多出一块方形
划词翻译面板展开问 AI 时会闪一下、跳一下
划词翻译面板弹出时偶尔被裁掉一截
拖边框改划词翻译面板的大小时，面板被收起
剪贴板面板点过右键之后，点别处收不起来
贴图出现时会跳一下
系统是深色、软件选了浅色时，侧边栏和面板上的字看不清
毛玻璃面板的圆角有锯齿
剪贴板面板开着毛玻璃时没有弹出动画
剪贴板面板不开毛玻璃时，阴影被切成一个方框

added: New macOS version (Apple silicon Macs)
English interface, following the system language by default
Youdao Translate: free, works without a proxy in mainland China
Recognized text is copied automatically (can be turned off in Settings)
Optional high-accuracy OCR engine (PaddleOCR) for handwriting, stylized fonts and complex layouts
Translation popup: edit the source text, pin it, and resize it from any edge
Choose single-click or double-click to paste from the clipboard panel
The clipboard panel slides up from the bottom of the screen (can be turned off in Settings)
Reorder the capture toolbar buttons by dragging them in Settings
New corners-only style for the selection frame
The clipboard panel can cover the taskbar (a switch in Settings)
improved: Renamed to DATO OCR; your data and settings are kept
Scrolling capture can go all the way down in one go and copies the result when done
Smoother dragging when selecting a screenshot area
Redesigned capture toolbar with more consistent icons
Translation results show the service's icon
Drag across lines to select recognized text
Clearer input box and results in the translation popup; text no longer overlaps behind the input
Text capture no longer auto-selects windows; you drag the area yourself
fixed: A square patch of frosted glass showed outside the rounded corners of glass panels
The translation popup flickered and jumped when opening Ask AI
The translation popup was sometimes cut off when it appeared
Resizing the translation popup by its edge closed it
The clipboard panel stayed open after a right-click when clicking elsewhere
Pinned images jumped when they appeared
Sidebar and panel text was hard to read with a dark system theme and the light app theme
Jagged rounded corners on frosted-glass panels
The clipboard panel had no slide animation with frosted glass on
The clipboard panel shadow was cut into a square with frosted glass off
